findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed a bottle of milk to be held past date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and milk was discarded. Ensure any TCS item is discarded after its date marking maximum.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed food splash to be accumulating in the following areas:
1) The bottom of the upstairs cooler.
2) The inside of the upstairs microwave.

Discussed with PIC, areas wil be cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Observed a leak to be present from pipe below triple sink. Discussed with PIC, a licensed plumber will be contacted to service leak. Ensure a licensed plumber services leak, inspector will follow up on 4/28/26.
findings.citation_text: 5-403.11 Approved Sewage Disposal System. SEWAGE shall be disposed through an APPROVED facility that is: (A) A public SEWAGE treatment plant; or (B) An individual SEWAGE disposal system that is sized, constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a coffee machine and a tea machine to have soiled grounds in the baskets. This was in a separate area for staging dinners, not in the main kitchen. The dispensers were NOT in use, the food remnants were from a previous service. Discussed with PIC, and the PIC emptied the containers and took them to the dish room. Ensure that all food served to customers is safe. These dispenser baskets can soil fast, ensure they are cleaned out as needed.
findings.citation_text: 3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a small build-up of soils on the ice machine baffle. Discussed with PIC and PIC cleaned the baffle immediately. Ensure that the baffle is cleaned regularly enough to keep soils from building up.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.
